I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

I checked that he's a member of that channel first. Then I read it and nothing else. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch stacking totes beside door 4. Her resolution note at 18:43 the same day says Southgate cleared the backlog.
